closure_targets.name: cusp_transit_loss_probability
closure_targets.pic_observable: L_k / je_arriving,k: window-averaged electron wall current in the cusp window (|z - z_c| <= w) over the electron current arriving at the cusp plane from the exit side, from the Kornfeld chain je_k = je_{k-1} - L_k + I_k seeded with the injected/cathode current that enters the channel
closure_targets.plasma_network_v2_parameter: SheathClosureInputs.declared_cusp_probabilities[k] (CL-1) / anode_cusp_probability (anode-most cusp)

closure_targets.name: cusp_electron_wall_current
closure_targets.pic_observable: e x sum over the cusp window of wall_electron_flux x wall area (maps.npz wall_electron_flux_per_m2_s)
closure_targets.plasma_network_v2_parameter: L_k in rows R23-R26 / R35-R37 (the lost electron current)

closure_targets.name: cusp_ion_wall_current
closure_targets.pic_observable: e x sum over the cusp window of wall_ion_flux x wall area
closure_targets.plasma_network_v2_parameter: PlasmaState.cusp_ion_current_a[k] (ambipolar balance of the sheath rows)

closure_targets.name: effective_cusp_loss_coefficient
closure_targets.pic_observable: L_k / (e N_e,cell) with N_e,cell the window-averaged electron inventory of the cell upstream of the cusp: the electron loss frequency the reduced model implies
closure_targets.plasma_network_v2_parameter: derived: p_k x (je_arriving / e N_e) - the cross-field transport the four-cell model has no explicit slot for (disclosure: it enters only through p_k)

closure_targets.name: cusp_leak_width
closure_targets.pic_observable: FWHM of the wall electron flux profile about z_c
closure_targets.plasma_network_v2_parameter: SheathClosureInputs.leak_width_prefactor (CL-4: width / hybrid gyroradius at the cusp wall field)

closure_targets.name: cusp_sheath_drop
closure_targets.pic_observable: phi(axis, z_c) - phi(wall, z_c) and the near-wall drop phi(wall - 3 dr) - phi(wall) (pic_context proxy)
closure_targets.plasma_network_v2_parameter: SheathClosureState.sheath_drop_v[k]; with T_k gives c_s,k = Delta phi / T_k -> CuspSheathSpec.area_ratio via ln(K0 rho_k) and the regime

closure_targets.name: cusp_near_wall_temperature
closure_targets.pic_observable: density-weighted T_e in the last 0.5 mm before the wall over the cusp window
closure_targets.plasma_network_v2_parameter: PlasmaState.electron_temperature_ev[k] (sheath coefficient argument)

closure_targets.name: cusp_wall_field
closure_targets.pic_observable: |B| at (r_w, z_c) of the bound P2 map (scaled)
closure_targets.plasma_network_v2_parameter: CuspSheathSpec.wall_field_t (CL-4)

closure_targets.name: cusp_electron_density
closure_targets.pic_observable: window-averaged n_e in the near-wall band of the cusp window
closure_targets.plasma_network_v2_parameter: CuspSheathSpec.electron_density_per_m3 (CL-4)

closure_targets.name: cell_ionisation_share
closure_targets.pic_observable: S_k / S: volume integral of ionization_rate_per_m3_s over the cell (2 pi r dr dz) over the domain total (the renderer's cusp-plane 'flames')
closure_targets.plasma_network_v2_parameter: PlasmaState.ionization_source_current_a[k] / sum (e S_k = I_k)

closure_targets.name: cell_ion_wall_loss_fraction
closure_targets.pic_observable: e-weighted wall ion current of the cell over the ionisation current of the cell (bounded above by the collisionless screening P(wall) = 1)
closure_targets.plasma_network_v2_parameter: closes ji_k in the ion current rows R06-R11; the quantity the saturated screening-v2 label could not resolve

closure_targets.name: cell_potential
closure_targets.pic_observable: n_e-weighted phi over the cell
closure_targets.plasma_network_v2_parameter: PlasmaState.plasma_potential_v[k]; steps phi_{k+1} - phi_k -> PotentialClosure.interior_step_3_v / _4_v (CL-3-potentials)

closure_targets.name: cell_temperature
closure_targets.pic_observable: n_e-weighted T_e over the cell
closure_targets.plasma_network_v2_parameter: PlasmaState.electron_temperature_ev[k]

closure_targets.name: discharge_current
closure_targets.pic_observable: window anode electron + ion current (summary.window_currents_a.discharge_a)
closure_targets.plasma_network_v2_parameter: SheathClosureInputs.anode_current_a (input) / row R11 closure

closure_targets.name: ionisation_rate
closure_targets.pic_observable: window S (neutral_inventory ionization rate)
closure_targets.plasma_network_v2_parameter: sum_k I_k / e

closure_targets.name: utilisation
closure_targets.pic_observable: gross e S / (e Q_in) and net (S - recycled) / Q_in (v1.4 ledger)
closure_targets.plasma_network_v2_parameter: mass utilisation of the reduced model's beam current ji_1 / (e Q_in)

closure_targets.name: anode_ion_fraction
closure_targets.pic_observable: window anode ion current / discharge current
closure_targets.plasma_network_v2_parameter: anode row R31 (anode sheath: identifies phi_4 - Ua from the anode ion fraction)

closure_targets.name: beam_current
closure_targets.pic_observable: far-field ion current (summary.plume / window exit_ion_beam_a)
closure_targets.plasma_network_v2_parameter: ji_1 (beam ion current leaving cell 1)

closure_targets.name: divergence_half_angles
closure_targets.pic_observable: 50 / 90 / 95 % current half-angles (plume_ion_current_per_sr_a histogram)
closure_targets.plasma_network_v2_parameter: none in the four-cell model (disclosure; beam efficiency input of any thrust estimate)

closure_targets.name: thrust
closure_targets.pic_observable: thrust_total_n of the momentum ledger (development number until the plateau rule holds)
closure_targets.plasma_network_v2_parameter: none (downstream performance estimate; the model's beam power P_beam = Ua x ji_1 is the comparable)

electron_source.plume: cathode annulus in the exit flux tube, continuity rule (v2.0 template)

operating_point_policy.feed_rule: Q_in = c n_g0, c = v_bar A_exit / 4 at the design's exit area (equal initial neutral density)

preregistration.attempt_8_verdict: recorded in ac248e05 (2026-09-04 11:57 AEST): grid-heating triad gate stop at 4.98 us (S drift 0.253), NO plateau; finite-grid heating from ~2.4 us once the peak-node Delta/lambda_D crossed ~3.2 (CIC threshold pi); the accepted channel-only plateau sat at 3.17 with a residual closing to +0.4 %; resolution decision Delta <= 32.4 um, dt <= 1.48 ps; v2.1 NOT launched

preregistration.blocked_on: the operating-point / grid decision that follows the verdict: the channel-only 33 um / 1.4 ps grid-refinement run (or a lower operating point at 50 um) and the recalibrated peak-Debye / residual-power gates
preregistration.state: NOT preregistered; this file is a DRAFT and is not hash-bound to any run

recommended_option.grid: the grid the attempt-8 follow-up validates: 50 um / 1.5 ps if the recalibrated peak-Debye gate admits the design's peak, else the 33 um / 1.4 ps refinement variant (cost row channel-33um-1.4ps)
recommended_option.plume_run: plume-24mm for the reference design only, and only at an operating point / grid that resolves the peak (attempt 8 did not)
recommended_option.reason: the closure targets are channel quantities (cusp losses, cell potentials, ionisation shares); the plume box costs 3.6-6x per transit and answers a different question (thrust, divergence); the accepted plateaus are channel-only

recommended_schedule.note: serial on one RTX 5090; +~10 % if the particle count keeps growing past the projected plateau (attempt 8 added 0.6 M ions/us); budgets should be set at 1.25x the projected wall so the plateau rule can be evaluated past 3 transits

refined_grid_schedule.note: serial on one RTX 5090; +~10 % if the particle count keeps growing past the projected plateau (attempt 8 added 0.6 M ions/us); budgets should be set at 1.25x the projected wall so the plateau rule can be evaluated past 3 transits

replication_policy.decision_rule: a design effect counts only if it exceeds the seed replicate spread AND the reference's seed/W spread
replication_policy.seed_replicate: l1a-gs-v3-056-effcbc8686 (seed 20260904) - the HEMP-like design; the reference's seed-b / W x 0.7 pair exists (<= 1.1 % / <= 5.7 %)
replication_policy.w_replicate: none in budget; the reference W x 0.7 record is the W-sensitivity statement

stopping_rule.plateau: relative drift < 5 % over the trailing 20 % of elapsed simulated time for I_d, N_e and n_g (linear fit), evaluated at every checkpoint, only after >= 3 ion transits, triad inside soft bounds (the accepted steady-state rule, verbatim)
stopping_rule.transit_rule: 2.4 us x L / 24 mm + L_plume / 17 km/s a priori; the measured N_i / L residence supersedes it
